rationale.target_validity: Use the previously frozen Q95/HJ-style station-support gate.
rationale.same_local_year: Preserves the frozen split protocol boundary: December 2022 is history/context only and may not fit model weights or data-dependent transforms; the same rule prevents issue/target pairs from crossing later calendar-year boundaries.

predictor_missingness.policy: Predictor NaNs do not globally delete a sample. They are handled by model-input-specific, fold-local preprocessing.

fold_local_preprocessing_default_v1.imputation: per-feature median fitted on formal FIT samples only
fold_local_preprocessing_default_v1.standardization: for schema-designated continuous features, mean/std are fitted after median imputation on the same formal FIT samples

public_rebuild_note: Frozen protocol rules only. Historical internal audit receipts and observations are not distributed; users reconstruct and audit their own inputs.
